rice_gate.reason: The wheat-grain Roboflow v1 card is a promising non-rice candidate (5,155 images, CC BY 4.0) but it is not downloaded and source groups/class balance are unverified. Existing rice positives lack verified group IDs. The real-image gate trainer is not implemented and raises NotImplementedError after a manifest is supplied. No approved manifest or training run is possible yet.

segmentation.reason: GrainSet has paired single-kernel masks, but filename-derived capture groups overlap across train/test (2,473 groups), it shares every GrainDet basename, and its separate rice.xml is absent locally. These masks do not establish a leakage-safe bulk-scene instance-segmentation corpus.

foreign_matter.reason: The 224-image Roboflow quality export includes foreign_object boxes, but its 22-image test split and unknown original capture groups do not support approved evaluation; the broad class also does not map to stone/organic/inorganic project classes. The other Roboflow export has unnamed numeric polygon classes.

chalky.reason: Only the 224-image Roboflow quality export names chalky_rice; it uses boxes rather than the mask input expected by the current trainer, has a 22-image test split, and lacks original source-group IDs. Other sources do not provide verified chalky-vs-clean labels.

sprouted_weevilled.reason: The local GrainDet/GrainSet folders have coded classes but no verified sprouted or weevilled class. Pest-attacked is not evidence of weevil damage, and their filename-derived groups leak across splits. No eligible labeled corpus exists.
